rows.heading: Employee Self-Service (ESS) Portal Access
rows.quote_snippet: 4.1 Authorized Digital Channel: The Employee Self-Service (ESS) web portal is the sole authorized digital system for employees to access their individual employment and payroll records. 4.2 Scope of Personal Self-Service Access: Through the authenticated ESS portal, an employee is authorized to view only their OWN personal records:    (a) Monthly payslip and annual Form 16 / tax computation statement;    (b) Leave account balance and application status;    (c) Personal e-APAR scorecards and self-appraisal submissions;    (d) Personal provident fund (EPF) and PRBS pension corpus balances;    (e) Official posting history and current work centre profile.
